proposed.sourceName: MUI (Indonesian Council of Ulama) — Fatwa No. 33 of 2011 on Cochineal Coloring
proposed.paraphrase: MUI Fatwa No. 33/2011 declares cochineal-derived food and drink colorings halal, reasoning that the cochineal insect is analogous to the (permitted) locust, lives on cactus/clean plants and feeds on plants rather than filth, and poses no harm — representing the permissive side of a genuinely contested question.

proposed.sourceName: General Iftaa' Department of Jordan — Fatwa No. 3240 on Carmine (E120)
proposed.paraphrase: Jordan's state Iftaa Department permits carmine (E120) via istihalah — when the cochineal-derived material undergoes chemical transformation into a new edible substance it is rendered permissible — subject to conditions (genuine transformation, need, limited amount, no harm); the permissive/lenient reading relies on this transformation argument.

researcherNote: E120 seeded lenient = grade 2 (Questionable — widely accepted). The lenient position follows real authorities that permit carmine: MUI (analogy to locust) and Jordan's Iftaa Department (istihalah/transformation). Both tier-1 state/national fatwa bodies, independent of each other. NOTE: this is the permissive side of a genuine split whose strict side (majority prohibition) grounds the grade-4 general/zabiha/hanafiStrict cells — cited honestly on each side. Two independent sources. APPROVED by owner 2026-07-01.
